stem: An 18-month-old with suspected inhaled foreign body cannot cooperate with expiratory chest films. Which additional chest radiographic view is most useful?
explanation: When a young child cannot cooperate with expiratory views, lateral decubitus chest radiographs can help demonstrate air trapping from an inhaled foreign body.
